items.title: Big Tech earnings meet IPO buzz: What to watch Thursday
items.summary: Asking for a Trend Host Josh Lipton previews the biggest market catalysts for Thursday, July 30, including highly anticipated earnings from Apple (AAPL) and Amazon (AMZN) as well as the expected IPO debuts of Jersey Mike's and Reformation.

items.title: Apple options trades: What's a covered call and how does it work?
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre tracks options trading activity around Apple (AAPL) shares, specifically explaining how a covered call works. Apple will be reporting its fiscal third quarter earnings results after the closing bell on Thursday, July 30.
